title: AnomalyScore-AI: Baseline Anomaly Detection Benchmark for LLM Agent Behavior

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: a benchmark for anomaly detection in agent behavior enables comparison of monitoring approaches. However, whether simple anomaly detectors (isolation forest, SVM) are actually competitive with LLM monitors for this task is unknown; the benchmark may show classical methods are inadequate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running an LLM agent under normal and adversarial conditions (ControlArena bash setting), extracting and labeling action sequences, then implementing three anomaly detectors. Setting up ControlArena and running agents requires significant infrastructure work beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple phases: agent data generation, labeling, feature extraction, three detector implementations, evaluation, dataset release. Each is substantial. Even a minimal version requires significant setup. Exceeds 30 hours.
